title: The Knights Order
description:
Become a Knight as save a village from a goblin invasion.

Fight through intricate puzzles and defeat all goblins to advance to the next stage.
Push around objects such as rocks, boxes, and many more to make way or use them to crush goblins.
Or strike the goblins yourself with upmost justice.
Each stage offers increasing difficulty to test your mettle.

Face against giant goblin bosses with their unique gimmick and prove your might.

Uncover a grander story accompanied by anime arts.
Find out the true nature of the Knights, are they the beacon of hope or something worse waiting to happen?

Bring the fight to the evil force.
From the village then straight to their nest.
Leave none of them alive!
description_short: A simple puzzle game about a Knight saving a village from goblin invasion.
